prompt: I want to add a real-time notification system to my FleetOps app. Users should get notified when a trip is assigned to them, when a vehicle needs maintenance, and when a dispatch changes. We use Supabase for the backend. I need you to plan this feature — design the database tables, the API endpoints, the real-time subscriptions, the UI components, and give me a step-by-step implementation plan. Think about architecture, edge cases, security, and how it integrates with the existing system. Don't write any code yet — just the plan.
assertions: Output includes an analysis of existing notification infrastructure before proposing new work
Output proposes a notification_preferences table design with proper foreign keys
Output includes a database schema design with SQL or schema notation
Output includes an implementation plan with sequenced steps (what to build first, second, third)
Output covers security considerations including RLS policies
Output identifies at least 5 edge cases or potential failure modes
Output addresses integration with existing auth system (employee_id, user_id)
Output proposes real-time subscription architecture using Supabase Realtime
